en.title: Count Tiles in 1D Othello
en.description:
Initially the board holds a black tile and a white tile, from left to right. Each character of the transcript is one move: moves 1, 3, 5, … place black tiles, and moves 2, 4, 6, … place white tiles; L/R means placing at the left/right end of the current row of tiles. After a move, if there is a nearest tile of the same color in that direction, flip all tiles between the new tile and that tile; otherwise flip nothing. Output the final numbers of black and white tiles.

The standard input/output format and supplementary constraints stated by this site are part of the online version's definition and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The input is a transcript string containing only L and R, of length 1..3000. Every move must place a tile.
en.output: Output the number of black tiles and the number of white tiles, separated by a single space.
en.explanation: Simulate the one-dimensional board step by step following the transcript. In the direction of the move, find the nearest tile of the same color and flip the tiles between it and the new tile.
